<thought>Search the template catalog using only the functional group that is definitely formed in the Still‑Gennari reaction – a carbon‑carbon double bond. This should return a small set of templates, among which the correct one will be present.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
